tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: App and page background behind the listing feed. ink 16.6:1, ink-muted 7.1:1 on it.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Result cards, search field, sheets and dialogs. ink 17.9:1, ink-muted 7.6:1 on it.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Skeleton loaders, disabled fields, the inline category dropdown well inside the search bar.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline card outlines and dividers. Decorative only — never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Boundaries of inputs, chips and secondary buttons: 3.7:1 on surface-card, 3.5:1 on surface-page (meets the 3:1 non-text rule).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text: provider names, headings, body. 17.9:1 on surface-card light, 13.8:1 dark.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary meta text: address, hours, review counts, captions. 7.6:1 on surface-card light, 7.3:1 dark — still AAA in sunlight.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on solid primary, trust and danger fills.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Civic navy. App bar, primary buttons, links, selected tab, key brand moments. White on it 11.2:1; as text on white 11.2:1. Dark: ink-inverse on it 8.7:1.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Pressed / hover state of primary fills.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Community Approved badge fill, selected list rows, info banners. primary text on it 9.7:1 light, 6.4:1 dark.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Saffron accent. Focus rings, the active-filter indicator, search-match highlight underline, count bubbles. 5.2:1 on surface-card light, 7.2:1 dark. Never for errors.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Active filter chip fill and highlighted search term background.

tokens.name: on-accent-soft
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent-soft. 6.4:1 light, 9.2:1 dark.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px outline + 2px offset on every focusable element. Alias of accent.

tokens.name: trust
tokens.usage: Trust green — reserved for verification, Open-now status and the WhatsApp quick action. White on it 5.0:1; dark: ink-inverse on it 10.5:1. Never decorative.

tokens.name: trust-hover
tokens.usage: Pressed / hover state of the WhatsApp button and solid trust badges.

tokens.name: trust-soft
tokens.usage: Verified badge fill, Open-now pill fill.

tokens.name: on-trust-soft
tokens.usage: Text and icons on trust-soft. 6.5:1 light, 11.0:1 dark.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Emergency alerts, destructive actions, error borders. White on it 6.5:1; dark: ink-inverse on it 6.6:1.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: 24×7 Emergency tag fill, error banners.

tokens.name: on-danger-soft
tokens.usage: Text on danger-soft. 6.8:1 light, 8.5:1 dark.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Closes-soon pill, unverified-listing notice, offline banner.

tokens.name: on-warning-soft
tokens.usage: Text on warning-soft. 6.2:1 light, 11.6:1 dark.

tokens.name: neutral-badge
tokens.usage: Muted badge background: category tag, sub-locality tag, Closed pill.

tokens.name: on-neutral-badge
tokens.usage: Text on neutral-badge. 9.2:1 light, 9.1:1 dark.

tokens.name: rating-star
tokens.usage: Filled rating star glyph only (an icon, 3:1+). The number beside it is always ink.

families.display: "Plus Jakarta Sans", "Noto Sans Devanagari", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif
families.sans: Inter, "Noto Sans Devanagari", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

styles.name: title-page
styles.usage: H1 — page title / search header. 32px / 40px from 768px up.

styles.name: title-section
styles.usage: H2 — feed sections, sheet titles. 24px / 32px from 768px up.

styles.name: title-card
styles.usage: H3 — provider name on a result card. Max 2 lines, then ellipsis.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Wiring, inverter installation and MCB repairs. Same-day visits in Baner and Balewadi.
styles.usage: Body and descriptions. Never below 16px on mobile (prevents iOS zoom in inputs too).

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Inline emphasis, rating number, field labels.

styles.name: meta
styles.sample: Baner Road · Open until 9 pm · 1.2 km
styles.usage: Caption / meta details — address, hours, distance, phone. Weight 500 holds up in glare.

styles.name: badge
styles.usage: Micro-badges and status tags. Sentence case, never all-caps. 12px is the floor for any text.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button labels and chip labels (chips use 14px / 20px).

spacing.note: 4px base grid; 8px rhythm for layout. Card padding space-4, feed gap space-3 mobile / space-6 desktop.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside badges, meta separators.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between badges, between the two CTA buttons, chip padding-y.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Chip padding-x, gap between card rows, feed gap on mobile.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, page side margin on mobile, button padding-x.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Search bar padding-x, sheet padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Feed gap and page margin from 768px, section spacing.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space above section titles, page margin from 1200px.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Empty-state vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target (height of CTAs, chips' hit area, list rows).

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Sticky header height, empty-state illustration block.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Micro-badges, status tags, highlight marks.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, inline dropdown.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Result cards, sheets, banners.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Search bar pill, filter and locality chips, avatars.

shadow.note: Flat by default: cards are border-only in the feed. Shadow is reserved for things that float above scrolling content.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: Default result card (border carries the edge).

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Pressed/hovered card, featured card, desktop grid hover.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Sticky search header once scrolled, bottom sheets, dropdown menus.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of any tappable target (WCAG 2.5.8 asks 24px; we use 48px).

tokens.name: search-height
tokens.usage: Master search bar height.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Icons in buttons and the search bar.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons in meta rows and badges (14px inside 12px badges is fine).

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum feed width on desktop.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Large phones / small tablets: search shows category dropdown inline.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Feed becomes 2 columns; type scale steps up.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Feed becomes 3 columns; page margin space-8.
